wellPillars: Every morning under the palapa, facing the sea. Led by experienced instructors, all levels welcome.
Included for hotel guests · day visitors reserve ahead
A sacred Mayan sweat lodge, led by a trained guide. Heat, darkness, herbs, breath.
Arrive hydrated · no heavy meals 3 hours before
Open-air treatments steps from the Caribbean, customized to what your body actually needs.
wellGroup: Private group bookings available for retreats, bachelorettes and corporate teams.
expSub: Tulum doesn't happen to you. You happen to Tulum.
expBody: An amenity is something you check off a list. An experience is something you talk about when you get home.
cenoteBody: Casa Tortuga is a complex of cenotes in the jungle — open pools, cave systems and jungle trails, under 30 minutes from the beach. Access is complimentary with every stay. You only pick the shuttle.
